sections.content: How many people are "protective service associate professionals (other)"?

63,705 people

were counted on the census as "protective service associate professionals (other)" in England and Wales in March 2021.

People who do this type of work may inspect goods to ensure compliance with regulations concerning payment of duty, establish that persons entering and leaving the UK have necessary authorisation for crossing national borders, monitor maritime conditions, undertake search and rescue operations, plan and coordinate services of private detective agencies and security measures for individuals, establishments or organisations, investigate activities such as fraud and other crimes, and perform other security and protective service occupations not elsewhere classified.

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "protective service associate professionals (other)" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "protective service associate professionals (other)", 13.5% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "protective service associate professionals (other)" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "protective service associate professionals (other)" included:

  • office supervisors
  • youth and community workers
  • registered mental health nurses

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "protective service associate professionals (other)" there were more men than women (61.9% compared with 38.1%).

This means "protective service associate professionals (other)" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "protective service occupations".

Men made up 61.9% and women made up 38.1% of "protective service associate professionals (other)"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "protective service associate professionals (other)" included:

  • glass and ceramics makers, decorators and finishers
  • inspectors of standards and regulations
  • food, drink and tobacco process operatives

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "protective service associate professionals (other)" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged 50 years and older, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "protective service associate professionals (other)" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "protective service associate professionals (other)", 10.4% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (87.5% compared with 12.5%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (94.9%) than self-employed (5.1%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Dover, this is in the same region of the South East.
